name: Jolly
source:
Mondo's right-hand man, and the second highest ranking member in the Family who bears Arcana - The Moon (#18) with a Mark on his right eye. His power lets him forcibly draw out a persons memory. He's the family's counselor but because of his cold-hearted and emotionless actions and words, almost everyone on the island avoids him as the very incarnation of terror. He is also the best at Alchemy on the island. [spoiler]He is also Luca's father,[/spoiler] though his actual age is unknown. His main weapon is Alchemy. Jolly also has the hobby of experimenting. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_storia_della_Arcana_Famiglia#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
